text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite being impressed by the strength of the other racers at the Takarazuka Kinen, Mejiro Dober remains focused on what she really has to defeat—her own weakness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Air Groove, noticing a change in Mejiro Dober, looks forward to seeing her performance.
